name: Gansu Jiu Steel Group Hongxing Iron & Steel Co.,Ltd.
summary: Gansu Jiu Steel Group Hongxing Iron & Steel Co.,Ltd. produces and sells iron, steel, and related rolled products in China. The company provides steel products, such as carbon steel cold-rolled, hot rolled coil, high-speed wire, carbon steel plate, rods, stainless steel hot-rolled strip and plate, stainless steel cold-rolled strip, carbon steel galvanized plates, and carbon steel hot-rolled products; and aluminum ingots, aluminum cast rolled plate, profiles, aluminum alloy doors and windows, and anode carbon blocks.
